title: Dasakam 49 – Bṛndāvanapraveśam
description: The cowherd community leaves Gokula and enters Vrindavan, where Krishna beholds the forest, Yamuna and Govardhana before tending calves with Balarama and the boys.
translation_note: No vetted English stanza translation is included. The numbered material in intake/D049/photo-captions.txt is preserved as supplied source commentary, not as photo captions or an approved translation.

stanzas.sanskrit:
भवत्प्रभावाविदुरा हि गोपा-
-स्तरुप्रपातादिकमत्र गोष्ठे ।
अहेतुमुत्पातगणं विशङ्क्य
प्रयातुमन्यत्र मनो वितेनुः ॥ ४९-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhavatprabhāvāvidurā hi gōpāstaruprapātādikamatra gōṣṭhē |
ahētumutpātagaṇaṁ viśaṅkya prayātumanyatra manō vitēnuḥ || 49-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopas were not aware of  Bhagwan Krishna's glory and greatness. So they misunderstood that the happenings like falling of trees and other incidents as bad omens. So they made up their minds and decided to migrate to some other place.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तत्रोपनन्दाभिधगोपवर्यो
जगौ भवत्प्रेरणयैव नूनम् ।
इतः प्रतीच्यां विपिनं मनोज्ञं
बृन्दावनं नाम विराजतीति ॥ ४९-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tatrōpanandābhidhagōpavaryō jagau bhavatprēraṇayaiva nūnam |
itah pratīcyāṁ vipinaṁ manōjñaṁ vr̥ndāvanaṁ nāma virājatīti || 49-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: A  leading person among the Gopas named Upananda, prompted by Bhagwan from within, suggested that there is a beautiful forest to the west of Gokula called the Brindavan which will be a proper location for settlement.

stanzas.sanskrit:
बृहद्वनं तत्खलु नन्दमुख्या
विधाय गौष्ठीनमथ क्षणेन ।
त्वदन्वितत्वज्जननीनिविष्ट-
-गरिष्ठयानानुगता विचेलुः ॥ ४९-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
br̥hadvanaṁ tatkhalu nandamukhyā vidhāya gauṣṭhīnamatha kṣaṇēna |
tvadanvitatvajjananīniviṣṭa-gariṣṭhayānānugatā vicēluḥ || 49-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan along with other Gopas converted their present living place  into a cowshed and with great enthusiasm set out to Brindavan. Yashoda lifted Krishna and sat on the cart and all the Gopas followed the cart.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अनोमनोज्ञध्वनिधेनुपाली-
-खुरप्रणादान्तरतो वधूभिः ।
भवद्विनोदालपिताक्षराणि
प्रपीय नाज्ञायत मार्गदैर्घ्यम् ॥ ४९-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The sounds of the cattle and the cart was so beautiful to hear. Krishna was keeping the gopas and gopikas entertained with his pranks and sweet talks so much that the distance of travel did not matter to them at all.

stanzas.sanskrit:
निरीक्ष्य बृन्दावनमीश नन्दत्-
-प्रसूनकुन्दप्रमुखद्रुमौघम् ।
अमोदथाः शाद्वलसान्द्रलक्ष्म्या
हरिन्मणीकुट्‍टिमपुष्टशोभम् ॥ ४९-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nirīkṣya vr̥ndāvanamīśa nandatprasūnakundapramukhadrumaugham |
amōdathāḥ śādvalasāndralakṣmyā harinmaṇīkuṭṭimapuṣṭaśōbham || 49-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna was delighted to see Brindavan, which was covered with Kunda trees with flowers in full bloom. The grasslands looked like it is covered with green emerald stone everywhere.

The Gopas built their new houses forming a semi-circle, and settled down there and were sitting peacefully and comfortably. Along with the young boys of the Gopas, Krishna went about the whole place looking around admiringly, and enjoying the beauty of the forest.
River Yamuna, daughter of Kalinda was flowing with clear water. The swans on the river made beautiful cooing sounds. The lotus flowers in the river appeared like the smiling face of Yamuna.

stanzas.sanskrit:
मयूरकेकाशतलोभनीयं
मयूखमालाशबलं मणीनाम् ।
विरिञ्चलोकस्पृशमुच्चशृङ्गै-
-र्गिरिं च गोवर्धनमैक्षथास्त्वम् ॥ ४९-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
mayūrakēkāśatalōbhanīyaṁ mayūkhamālaśabalaṁ maṇīnām |
viriñcalōkaspr̥śamuccaśr̥ṅgai-rgiriṁ ca gōvardhanamaikṣathāstvam || 49-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna saw the majestic Govardhana mountains which was radiating light from the gems it contained. It was attractive with the sounds of the peacocks. Its high peaks were as though touching the abode of Brahma.

stanzas.sanskrit:
समं ततो गोपकुमारकैस्त्वं
समन्ततो यत्र वनान्तमागाः ।
ततस्ततस्तां कुटिलामपश्यः
कलिन्दजां रागवतीमिवैकाम् ॥ ४९-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
samaṁ tatō gōpakumāraistvaṁ samantatō yatra vanāntamāgāḥ |
tatastatastāṁ kr̥ṭilāmapaśyaḥ kalindajāṁ rāgavatīmivaikām || 49-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna with all other Gopas wandered all along the forest. He saw Yamuna river flowing full in curves following him everywhere as if she was trying to meet him in solitude.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तथाविधेऽस्मिन् विपिने पशव्ये
समुत्सुको वत्सगणप्रचारे ।
चरन् सरामोऽथ कुमारकैस्त्वं
समीरगेहाधिप पाहि रोगात् ॥ ४९-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tathāvidhē:’sminvipinē paśavyē samutsukō vatsagaṇapracārē |
caransarāmō:’tha kumārakaistvaṁ samīragēhādhipa pāhi rōgāt || 49-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Krishna Bhagwan along with Balram and other Gopas were taking care of the cows in the beautiful Brindavan. Bhattathiri prayed Lord Guruvaayurappan to cure him from all his diseases. 
Bhattathiri prayed to Krishna who was spending the days, tending the calves, along with his brother Balaram and other gopa boys in that beautiful Brindhavan, to cure him of all his afflictions.
